_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "users" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "username" TEXT NOT NULL, "nickname" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "first_name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "last_name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "position" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "locale" TEXT NULL, "is_bot" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_bot" IN (0, 1)), "roles" TEXT NULL, "update_at" INTEGER NULL, "delete_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_picture_update" INTEGER NULL, "timezone_json" TEXT NULL, "props_json" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'offline', "status_updated_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "teams" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "update_at" INTEGER NULL, "delete_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_team_icon_update" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "my_teams" ("team_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "roles" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "msg_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "mention_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "msg_count_root" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "mention_count_root" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("team_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "channels" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "team_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "header" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "purpose" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "creator_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "create_at" INTEGER NULL, "update_at" INTEGER NULL, "delete_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_post_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_root_post_at" INTEGER NULL, "total_msg_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "total_msg_count_root" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "shared" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("shared" IN (0, 1)), "group_constrained" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("group_constrained" IN (0, 1)), "member_count" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "my_channels" ("channel_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "roles" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "last_viewed_at" INTEGER NULL, "msg_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "msg_count_root" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "mention_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "mention_count_root" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "urgent_mention_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "manually_unread" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("manually_unread" IN (0, 1)), "notify_props_json" TEXT NULL, "last_update_at" INTEGER NULL, "posts_fetched_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("channel_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "team_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "sorting" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "muted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("muted" IN (0, 1)), "collapsed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("collapsed" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "category_channels" ("category_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "channel_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("category_id", "channel_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "posts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "channel_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "root_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "create_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "update_at" INTEGER NULL, "edit_at" INTEGER NULL, "delete_at" INTEGER NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "message" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "is_pinned" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_pinned" IN (0, 1)), "reply_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_reply_at" INTEGER NULL, "original_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "pending_post_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "send_state" TEXT NULL, "props_json" TEXT NULL, "metadata_json" TEXT NULL, "file_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "reaction_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "participant_ids_json" TEXT NULL, "decode_problem" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "post_ranges" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "scope" TEXT NOT NULL, "scope_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "earliest" INTEGER NOT NULL, "latest" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reaches_start" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("reaches_start" IN (0, 1)));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reactions" ("post_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "emoji_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "create_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("post_id", "user_id", "emoji_name"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "files" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "post_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "extension" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "mime_type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "size" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "width" INTEGER NULL, "height" INTEGER NULL, "has_preview" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("has_preview" IN (0, 1)), "mini_preview" BLOB NULL, "local_path" TEXT NULL, "delete_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "threads" ("root_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "channel_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_reply_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_viewed_at" INTEGER NULL, "reply_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "unread_replies" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "unread_mentions" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "is_following" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_following" IN (0, 1)), "participant_ids_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', PRIMARY KEY ("root_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "thread_teams" ("team_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "root_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("team_id", "root_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "thread_sync" ("team_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "earliest" INTEGER NOT NULL, "latest" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("team_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "custom_emoji" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "creator_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "create_at" INTEGER NULL, "delete_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "preferences" ("category" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("category", "name"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "roles" ("name" TEXT NOT NULL, "permissions_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', PRIMARY KEY ("name"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "drafts" ("channel_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "root_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "message" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "selection_base" INTEGER NULL, "selection_extent" INTEGER NULL, "files_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "priority_json" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "synced_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("channel_id", "root_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "scheduled_posts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "team_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "channel_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "root_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "message" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "scheduled_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "update_at" INTEGER NULL, "error_code" TEXT NULL, "json" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "outbox" ("pending_post_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "channel_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "root_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "queued_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "next_attempt_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_error" TEXT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'queued', PRIMARY KEY ("pending_post_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "post_lists" ("list" TEXT NOT NULL, "post_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "rank" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("list", "post_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "search_history" ("team_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "term" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("team_id", "term"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "view_states" ("scope" TEXT NOT NULL, "scope_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "anchor_post_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "anchor_offset_px" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "saved_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("scope", "scope_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_state" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value_int" INTEGER NULL, "value_text" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "config" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "json" TEXT NOT NULL, "fetched_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "channel_bookmarks" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "channel_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "link_url" TEXT NULL, "image_url" TEXT NULL, "emoji" TEXT NULL, "file_id" TEXT NULL, "update_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "profile_fields" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "attrs_json" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "profile_values" ("user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "field_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "values_json" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("user_id", "field_id"));
CREATE INDEX channels_by_team ON channels (team_id)
CREATE INDEX categories_by_team ON categories (team_id)
CREATE INDEX posts_by_channel ON posts (channel_id, create_at)
CREATE INDEX posts_by_root ON posts (root_id, create_at)
CREATE INDEX posts_by_pending ON posts (pending_post_id)
CREATE INDEX post_ranges_by_scope ON post_ranges (scope, scope_id, latest)
CREATE INDEX reactions_by_post ON reactions (post_id)
CREATE INDEX files_by_post ON files (post_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX custom_emoji_by_name ON custom_emoji (name)
CREATE INDEX scheduled_posts_by_channel ON scheduled_posts (channel_id)
CREATE INDEX bookmarks_by_channel ON channel_bookmarks (channel_id)
